{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''This'' is a crystal round... and ''this'' is what happens to a crystal round when I activate my ''harmonic inducer''!|[[Sülphurr Cyander]]|<ref name="Spices & Spies" />}}
The '''crystal round''' was a device used by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Sülphurr Cyander]]. If added to a shot from a [[harmonic inducer]], it created an impenetrable [[crystal prison]]. During a [[Skirmish in Mos Espa|skirmish]] in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]], Cyander used a crystal round in an attempt to restrain [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] and [[Ttekket]].
